description: The metering basis for PER_UNIT pricing — the 'per what' a rate is charged against. Used in Pricing.unit (required when Pricing.model = PER_UNIT). The charging STRUCTURE (FREE / PER_UNIT / FLAT) is the closed PricingModel enum; the basis is this open, registry-governed vocabulary so new domains add a unit here instead of forcing a proto change. ISO-style two-letter currency lives in Pricing.currency, not here.
conformance: Bare tokens MUST be registered here. Custom units use a 'vendor:' namespace prefix (e.g. 'acme:per-render'); the ingestion linter warns on unregistered bare tokens and passes namespaced tokens silently. Cross-unit cost comparison is done on Pricing.unit_cost (normalized to the Exchange base currency), never by comparing unit strings.

units.description: One HTTP fetch / crawl of the resource.
units.notes: RSL 'crawl' payment type maps here. Bills per retrieval event regardless of downstream use. Distinct from accesses (a fetch may be cached and re-used without re-billing).

units.description: One distinct content access / read / use event.
units.notes: General-purpose per-event basis when a more specific unit does not apply. RSL 'purchase' (metered) and 'training' map here when billed per access.

units.description: LLM tokens generated from, or consumed reading, this content.
units.notes: The basis for inference/RAG (ai-input) and token-metered training. Direction (input vs output tokens) is a billing detail the Exchange and provider agree on; the protocol meters the count. RSL 'use' / 'inference' map here.

units.description: One API / RPC call that returns this resource.
units.notes: For resources delivered as an API response rather than a document. Distinct from fetches (HTTP retrieval of a static asset).
Legal filings, PDFs, books. One rendered/printed page = one unit.

units.description: One minute of audio or video runtime.
units.notes: Streaming and broadcast pricing. Partial minutes round per the provider's stated policy.
Dataset and database licensing. One row, document, or entity returned = one record.

units.description: One streaming session / connection to a live feed.
units.notes: Live resources (RESOURCE_MUTABILITY_LIVE). One concurrent connection for the session = one stream; duration-metered live use should instead price in minutes.

units.description: One still image or video frame.
units.notes: Stock media. Distinct from impressions (a display-side quota metric) — images counts licensed copies, not end-user displays.

units.description: One named user licensed to access the resource.
units.notes: Per-seat enterprise/dataset licensing. Requires the Exchange to track user identity across accesses.

units.description: One physical unit manufactured from or incorporating the licensed design.
units.notes: Use with Pricing.metering = OFFLINE_SELF_REPORTED — the Exchange cannot observe manufacturing events; the agent self-reports and the Exchange audits. Covers 3D-printed items, CNC parts, injection-molded products. Mirrors the units-manufactured quota metric.
Fine-grained text pricing where token boundaries are not meaningful (e.g. non-LLM text reuse, translation memory).
Raw-volume pricing for binary or bulk delivery. Prefer a semantic unit (records, pages, minutes) when one applies.

units.description: One generic licensed item when no more specific unit applies.
units.notes: Catch-all. Prefer a specific unit; 'items' is the registered fallback before resorting to a 'vendor:' namespaced custom unit.

units.description: One square kilometre of geospatial coverage.
units.notes: Satellite imagery and geospatial datasets, where licensing is by area covered rather than by file or record.
